text: Code reviews are an important part of software development. When developers review each other's code, they can catch bugs early, before the code goes into production. This saves time and money, because fixing problems later is much harder. Code reviews also support knowledge sharing. Team members learn from each other, discover new techniques, and understand different parts of the project. In addition, regular reviews improve team quality, because everyone follows the same standards and writes cleaner code. Although reviews take extra time, they are worth it. A strong review culture helps the whole team grow and produce better, more reliable software.
